verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects documents saving views so a user can return to them and make them available to the team, which covers saving and sharing a view with teammates. The evidence does not explicitly tie filtering to saved views, since the filter citation concerns insights charts, and it never mentions sharing via a link or URL. missing for 10: explicit documentation that filters persist in saved views, link/URL-based sharing of a view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can save a filtered view of work and share it with a link

citations.quote: You can save these views, allowing you to quickly return to them as needed and make them available to your team.
You can view your project as a high-density table layout, as a kanban board, or a timeline-style roadmap.
